grammar.0.title: Akkusativ pronouns — “me, you …”
grammar.0.note: Ich lade dich ein = I'm inviting you. Only er → ihn changes; the rest is a short list to learn by heart.
grammar.1.title: einladen — a separable verb
grammar.1.text: einladen = to invite: „Ich lade dich ein.“ With du, a → ä: „Du lädst mich ein.“ With a modal, the separable verb stays together: „Ich möchte dich einladen.“
grammar.2.title: Saying yes and saying no
quiz.6.why: With leider you can politely say that you can't.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order to make the question: “Do you have time on Saturday?”
